build_UpsampleCNN: build a 2D CNN module that upsamples feature maps by a factor of 2^upsample_power with configurable hidden dims
build_VolumeCNN: build a 3D U-Net structure that processes volumetric data through encoder-decoder convolutions with skip connections
build_VolumeResnet: build a 3D U-Net with residual convolution units before each downsampling and upsampling stage
build_InvResnetFpn3d: build a 3D inverted ResNet with FPN-style upsampling that fuses multi-scale features from four blocks
build_VolumeCNNHead: build a 3D CNN head with 2-4 layers that maps input features to a final output dimension
